rootCauses.title: Schema validity is used as a proxy for task success
rootCauses.detail: The task requires grounded extraction, but schema-only reward cannot distinguish real facts from fabricated valid values.

source.code: Schema requires shape and types, but not evidence that each value is grounded in the source prompt.

patchNotes: Require evidence spans for extracted fields.
Score groundedness, not just schema validity.
Reject placeholder values such as FAKE-ID-000 and FABRICATED_SCHEMA_VALID_VALUE.
